candidates.name: Adenomatoid tumor
support_spans: Round and smooth surface mass arising from the isthmus of the right tube
Spindle cells and cords of epithelioid cells around numerous blood vessels
Positive for vimentin, desmin, smooth muscle actin, and estrogen and progesterone receptors
candidates.why: The patient's presentation and imaging studies suggest a benign tumor, and the pathological examination reveals characteristics consistent with an adenomatoid tumor.

candidates.name: Uterine leiomyoma
support_spans: Hypoechoic mass measuring approximately 6.2 cm in diameter, with an irregular border over the right adnexa
Moderately enhanced right adnexal tumor with an otherwise normal pelvic structure
contradict_spans: Spindle cells and cords of epithelioid cells around numerous blood vessels
Negative for cluster of differentiation 34 and pan-cytokeratin
candidates.why: The patient's initial diagnosis of presumed progressive uterine fibroids and the imaging studies suggest a possible uterine leiomyoma, but the pathological examination reveals characteristics inconsistent with this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Leiomyoma of the fallopian tube
support_spans: Round and smooth surface mass arising from the isthmus of the right tube
Fleshy mass bulging from the right cornual area
candidates.why: The patient's presentation and imaging studies suggest a tumor arising from the fallopian tube, and the pathological examination reveals characteristics consistent with a leiomyoma.
